seo_title: 13-Day Peru Itinerary with Coast, Andes & Amazon Adventure
meta_description: Discover Peru in 13 days from the coast to the Andes and the Amazon. Visit Lima, the Ballestas Islands, Huacachina dunes and Cusco.
itinerary_days: Day 2: Lima City Tour (Modern and Colonial centres and the Santo Domingo Convent) –03:30 hour tour
Day 3: Trip from Lima to Paracas
Day 4: Ballestas Islands - Paracas National Reserve - 05 hrs tour
Day 5: Ica City Tour (Regional Museum of Ica) - Huacachina (Tubular Walks) - 04 hrs tour
Day 7: Cusco City Tour (Cathedral, Qoricancha, Sacsayhuaman, Qenqo, Puka Pukara and Tambomachay) - 05 hrs tour
Day 8: The Sacred Valley of the Incas (Pisaq and Ollantaytambo) - connection to Aguas Calientes (8-hour tour)
Day 9: Machu Picchu – Cusco (2h30m  Tour) - private
Day 11: Lake Sandoval & Canopy Walkway , The Anaconda Walk
